notes: Two waw-for-*with* renderings (s019, s029) follow rule 14's open connective list; the earlier *and* at t022 stands before an asyndetic אֵת phrase with no conjunction morpheme in it, so it is `added`. Counting three waws against four English connectives is what settles this.

The italic *the palace* (t010–t011) is `added`: the Hebrew writes only the adverb פְּנִימָה, whose *within* is separately aligned, so this is rule 33's supplied-head-noun case. The alternative of folding *within the palace* whole into that adverb under rule 31 is named in the unit's note.

Both articles in the verse (s017, s027) sit on anarthrously-rendered recta and take the fronted *the* under rule 29; the four *the*s before *house* and *vessels* are supplied, no article morpheme standing in those chains.
